==Purpose of template==
Add a [[Calendar|date]] table entry sortable by the "number" type (doesn't prepend the |).

==How to use==
 <nowiki>{{SortableDate|AB or FY or NE|year}}</nowiki>

Currently, the template can only handle 4 (or 5?) digits in the year parameter.

==Example==

<pre>{| class="article-table sortable" 
|+
! data-sort-type="text" |Era
! data-sort-type="number" |Year
! data-sort-type="number" |Date
|-
|AB
|1
|{{SortableDate|AB|1}}
|-
|AB
|23
|{{SortableDate|AB|23}}
|-
|AB
|345
|{{SortableDate|AB|345|true}}
|-
|FY
|67
|{{SortableDate|FY|67}}
|-
|FY
|890
|{{SortableDate|FY|890|false}}
|-
|NE
|12
|{{SortableDate|NE|12}}
|-
|NE
|1000
|{{SortableDate|NE|1000}}
|}</pre>
